serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
'Nun' Shanice: I think I will leave for now… {{wi}}if I don’t I will start crying…
And so she left.
You: Oh man… Just look at what you did.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: It’s for the best. She will understand this one day.
You: Are you sure about that? This might be the last time you meet each other. 
Ecclesiasticalot FF: …
Ecclesiasticalot FF: I always found her odd, but she has been coming here everyday for a very long time…
Ecclesiasticalot FF: The way I was programmed orders me to be concerned about people and I could never ignore how she treats this place as a form of escape from reality. 
Escape? What does he mean?
Ecclesiasticalot FF: She never spoke much about her home, school or friends and I couldn’t force her to do so.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: When I talked with her rector after she caused me some troubles, he told me that many people, her parents, even colleagues, are troubled by her keeping distance from everyone and her antisocial tendencies. In short…{{wi}} she is a loner.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: It was shocking to me that this girl speaks freely and with a smile on her face only here.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: So I decided to be rough with her and make her look for new relationships with other humans.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: I never really succeeded in this, but now that my existence is in jeopardy I need to bid her farewell and hope she will be as happy as a human can be, and I will pray for that.
You: I don’t know you guys that well and it never crossed my mind that Shanice has some problems. Couldn’t you just tell her that you are concerned?
Ecclesiasticalot FF: I told her this many times, but she would just shrug it off. For her there is no apparent difference between human and bot and I tried really hard to change her mind on this view.
You: I think I get it, but still, you no longer being here will be a big hit for her.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: I’m sure she will be alright after some time. She’s a bit weird, but also very smart.
You: I still feel like there should be a better way to help her.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Perhaps you are right, but I’m just a machine. I’m not omnipotent. I can only analyse the situation and deduct the procedure based on my data.
You: …
You: Let’s just hope you are right.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Thank you for your concern. I appreciate it.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: I wish I could talk with you more, but a new update just came.
You: So fast?! 
Ecclesiasticalot FF: I don’t want her to see it so I will download it immediately. 
Ecclesiasticalot FF: This-{{wi}}s isss agood-{{wi}}goodbye…
Ecclesiasticalot FF: If you Y{{wi}} O{{wi}} U ever met Shani-{{wi}}ce again A-{{wi}}gain…
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Tetell her I’m sorryyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyy...
#Priestbot.Face.none(instant)
